{'text': 'Located in Kai Tak, the "Lung Tsun Stone Bridge Ancestral Hall" officially opens on October 13, bringing a declared monument that had been dormant for over half a century back into the light. The park\'s design blends modern walkways with historical relics, allowing visitors to admire the century-old bridge piers up close under elegant lighting.', 'paragraph_context': '位於啟德的「龍津石橋公園」， 10 月 13 日起正式開放，讓沉睡逾半世紀的法定古蹟重光。公園設計融合了現代步道與歷史遺跡，市民可在優美的燈光下，近距離觀賞百年橋墩細節。 園區內設有刻上「龍津」二字的標誌性仿古牌坊，除了展示 1873 年建成的龍津石橋遺蹟、石橋結構、上落船平台、碼頭石墩、接官亭等出土文物外，下層展覽廳有歷史展板，述說石橋周邊的昔日民間生活。'}

{'text': 'The park features an iconic replica archway inscribed with the characters "龍津" (Lung Tsun). In addition to displaying excavated artefacts including the Lung Tsun Stone Bridge remnants built in 1873, bridge structure, boarding platform, pier stone blocks, and the welcoming pavilion, the lower-level exhibition hall has historical panels recounting the everyday lives of people around the bridge in bygone days.', 'paragraph_context': '位於啟德的「龍津石橋公園」， 10 月 13 日起正式開放，讓沉睡逾半世紀的法定古蹟重光。公園設計融合了現代步道與歷史遺跡，市民可在優美的燈光下，近距離觀賞百年橋墩細節。 園區內設有刻上「龍津」二字的標誌性仿古牌坊，除了展示 1873 年建成的龍津石橋遺蹟、石橋結構、上落船平台、碼頭石墩、接官亭等出土文物外，下層展覽廳有歷史展板，述說石橋周邊的昔日民間生活。'}

{'text': 'Completed during the Guangxu era', 'paragraph_context': '光緒年間落成'}

{'text': 'The Kowloon City area has a long and storied history of development. As early as the Southern Song dynasty, the imperial court established the "Guanfu Salt Field" (官富場) in the Kowloon City area, reflecting its early economic and administrative importance. In 1873, during the Guangxu era of the Qing dynasty, the Lung Tsun Stone Bridge was built to meet the trade and defence needs of Kowloon Walled City. The bridge soon became a vital landing pier connecting Kowloon City with the outside world, cementing the area\'s status as a key maritime transportation route.', 'paragraph_context': '九龍城一帶的發展源遠流長。早在南宋時期，朝廷便於九龍城一帶設立「官富場」鹽場，彰顯其早期的經濟與行政重要性。至 1873 年清代光緒年間，為應付九龍寨城的通商與防衞需求，龍津石橋落成。這座石橋隨即成為九龍城連接外界的重要登岸碼頭，確立了該區作為水路出海交通要道的地位。'}

{'text': 'Japanese military landfill buried the stone bridge', 'paragraph_context': '日軍填海\u3000石橋被埋'}

{'text': 'Following reclamation works carried out by the Japanese military during the Japanese occupation, the Lung Tsun Stone Bridge was ultimately dismantled and buried underground. The original site later transformed into the world-famous Kai Tak Airport, which shouldered the mission of connecting the globe by air. From the Song dynasty\'s Guanfu Salt Field and the Qing dynasty\'s Lung Tsun pier to the modern-day Kai Tak Airport, this stretch of land stands as a perfect witness to the city\'s evolving role as a vital international "transportation hub" across different eras.', 'paragraph_context': '經歷日佔時期日軍的填海工程，龍津石橋最終被拆卸掩埋於地下。原址其後蛻變為舉世知名的啟德機場，肩負起連接全球的航空使命。從宋代的官富場、清代的龍津碼頭，到近代的啟德機場，這片土地完美見證了香港在不同時代皆作為重要中外「運輸樞紐」的角色演變。'}

{'text': 'Historical journey from sea to air transport', 'paragraph_context': '從海運到空運歷史軌跡'}

{'text': "Today, historical relics and modern green spaces complement each other beautifully. As visitors stroll along the walkways, they can appreciate these stone remnants that carry a century of history, experiencing Hong Kong's journey from maritime to aviation transport. It is understood that the exhibition hall on the lower level of the park will also be fully opened in due course, offering the public a deeper historical and cultural journey.", 'paragraph_context': '如今，歷史遺跡與現代化的綠化空間交相輝映。市民在步道漫步時，能細賞這些承載着百年歷史的石塊遺跡，感受香港從海運到空運的歷史軌跡。據悉，公園地下層的展覽廳亦將於不日全面開放，為大眾提供更深入的歷史文化之旅。'}
